"""Main-only exact cachepacket CPU fixtures; no engine/property/compiler launch."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from cache_support import CacheRun, HERE, P, closed, need, packet, sha, strong


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--main-reviewed', action='store_true', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    _, _, pins = packet()
    run = CacheRun(args.output, 120)
    run.r['controller_source_pins'] = pins
    error = None
    try:
        text, _ = run.run('parser-owned-mock-pending', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B',
            str(P / 'controller_cpu_fixtures.py'), '--owned-mock-output', str(args.output / 'mock'),
            '--invalid-pending-output', str(args.output / 'invalid-pending')], wall=60, cpu=60)
        result = json.loads(text)
        keys = ('parser_malformed_fixtures_passed', 'owned_mock_quit_passed',
                'invalid_admission_prelaunch_passed', 'invalid_pending_process_passed')
        need(all(result.get(key) is True for key in keys), 'actual parser/mock/pre-owner pending child')
        closed(dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, commands=result['commands']))
        need(result['invalid_pending_commands'] and
             all(strong(c) and c['exit_code'] == 1 for c in result['invalid_pending_commands']),
             'Expected invalid pending refusal remains exit1, normally reaped')
        run.r.update({key: result[key] for key in keys})
        run.r['fixture_result'] = result
        text, _ = run.run('CAPS-pure-fixtures', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', str(HERE / 'caps_fixtures.py')],
                          cwd=HERE, wall=30, cpu=30)
        run.r['caps_parser_fixtures'] = json.loads(text)
        need(run.r['caps_parser_fixtures']['passed'] is True, 'pure CAPS parser')
        need(all(sha(P / name) == digest for name, digest in pins.items()), 'exact unchanged seven sources')
        run.r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as caught:
        error = caught
    code = run.finish(error)
    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=run.r['passed'], error=run.r.get('error'))))
    return code


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
